title: Step 5: Decide Win, Lose, or Draw

blocks.content: Step 5: Decide Win, Lose, or Draw

items: add the get_result() function to the Game class to store the result of the game

blocks.content: The purpose of this function is to

items: return the game result based on our game logic

blocks.content: Here, the get_result() function compares the computer_pick and user_pick and returns

items: "draw" if the computer pick and the user pick are the same
"win" if the user wins using the rule we described earlier
"lose" if neither condition for draw and win is met
